# validate/decode_bad_csv_header — csv.header must be present or absent.

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_stdout.txt

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  url:
    type: url
    default: "http://localhost:9999"

auth:
  none: {}

requests:
  - method: GET
    url: {ref: state.url}

response:
  decode:
    - csv:
        header: maybe
  events_at: ""

pagination:
  none: {}

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_stdout.txt --
response.decode[0].header: error: csv.header must be present or absent, got "maybe"
